purpose: Separated source-pixel cutouts for native street-scene rigs; original reference sheets unchanged
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production cutout sprite atlas for an editable 2D skeletal animation. Reference is the approved character model sheet; preserve identity, outfit, organic rounded silhouettes, proportions, bold dark outline and subtle shading EXACTLY. Produce a genuinely transparent PNG, square 2000x2000 if possible. STRICT regular grid FIVE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 20 equally sized cells with wide transparent gutters, one isolated cutout centred in each cell; no text, no grid lines, no assembled full character, no shadows outside pieces. Cutouts drawn at consistent relative scale. All arm/leg segments point straight DOWN; circular rounded ends hidden under neighbouring segment, no square chopped joints. Head about 300px high, torso 270px, arms 140px, legs 160px. Draw the following exact row-major order:
Row1: three-quarter head WITH hair and ears but blank face (NO eyes eyebrows mouth); three-quarter torso including neck, NO head arms hands legs; upper sleeve segment shoulder-to-elbow; forearm sleeve elbow-to-wrist; relaxed mitten hand.
Row2: open palm-up mitten hand; pointing mitten hand; clenched mitten fist; upper trouser leg hip-to-knee; lower trouser leg knee-to-ankle.
Row3: shoe pointing RIGHT; true right-profile head with hair ears and BLANK face; true profile torso with neck no arms or legs; paired neutral eyes AND eyebrows on transparency NO face skin; paired angry eyes AND eyebrows no skin.
Row4: paired laughing closed eyes AND eyebrows no skin; small closed smiling mouth only no skin; open talking mouth with tongue only no skin; frowning mouth only no skin; paired surprised eyes AND eyebrows no skin.
Neutral eye style black ovals. Facial features must match reference not detailed anime. Preserve character skin colour on all hands and neck. Hair outline must preserve reference silhouette. Torso must have exactly their approved shirt/tie. Head has NO baked facial features, because these will be attached separately. Clean alpha; transparent background, not white or painted checkerboard.
